mission: Mission 15 — Temporal Failure Analysis & Diagnostic Taxonomy

TF-01_ghost_proposal_persistence.name: Ghost Proposal Persistence
TF-01_ghost_proposal_persistence.mechanism: Candidate proposal lingering after target vehicle has turned or departed

TF-02_camera_ego_motion_smear.name: Camera Ego-Motion Smear
TF-02_camera_ego_motion_smear.mechanism: Subpixel phase correlation error during road bumps, potholes, or rapid turns

TF-03_moving_dynamic_background.name: Moving Dynamic Background
TF-03_moving_dynamic_background.mechanism: Windshield wiper blade sweep or roadside trees in heavy storm creating false motion

TF-04_static_clutter_trapping.name: Static Clutter Trapping
TF-04_static_clutter_trapping.mechanism: Guardrail posts, traffic cones, or road markings triggering candidate thresholds

TF-05_sudden_vehicle_cut_in.name: Sudden Vehicle Cut-in
TF-05_sudden_vehicle_cut_in.mechanism: Overtaking vehicle entering frame with high lateral acceleration, violating linear history

TF-06_horizon_estimation_error.name: Horizon Estimation Error
TF-06_horizon_estimation_error.mechanism: Steep road crest or hill causing road convergence to depart from adaptive horizon band

TF-07_weather_contrast_extinction.name: Weather Contrast Extinction
TF-07_weather_contrast_extinction.mechanism: Severe snow spray or heavy downpour reducing target signal below sensor SNR floor

TF-08_headlight_reflection_blooming.name: Headlight & Reflection Blooming
TF-08_headlight_reflection_blooming.mechanism: Night oncoming high-beam saturation obscuring vehicle body geometry

TF-09_frame_dropping_discontinuity.name: Frame Dropping Discontinuity
TF-09_frame_dropping_discontinuity.mechanism: Timestamp discontinuity breaking multi-frame trajectory correlation

TF-10_cross_sequence_contamination.name: Cross-Sequence Contamination
TF-10_cross_sequence_contamination.mechanism: State leakage across video sequence boundaries (verified 0.0% by reset guard)

TF-11_edge_crop_budget_exhaustion.name: Edge Crop Budget Exhaustion
TF-11_edge_crop_budget_exhaustion.mechanism: Valid candidate discovered, but crop budget (K=2) exhausted by higher-density clusters

TF-12_crop_classification_localization_m.name: Crop Classification / Localization Miss
TF-12_crop_classification_localization_m.mechanism: High-resolution crop successfully placed, but detector failed to achieve IoU >= 0.50
